France-EU FTAs incl. EU-CETA and Japan EPA

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-50 (as amended by Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 and Décret n° 2021-1675 du 15 décembre 2021); Code de commerce Articles L. 561-45 à L. 561-49 and R. 561-1 et seq. (register of beneficial owners); Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5AMLD) and Directive (EU) 2024/1640 (AMLA/6AMLD) transposition in progress; Loi n° 2024-364 du 22 avril 2024 on the beneficial ownership register reporting obligations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each UBO and SAS President
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry / consulate of origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961) if origin state is party; otherwise Consular Legalization at French Embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / foreign company registry extract of corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of shareholder's domicile

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Good Standing Certificate (certificat de bonne vie et mœurs) of corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax authority or official trade registry of foreign jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney to the French legal representative (résident)
Criminal record certificate (extrait de casier judiciaire) of proposed SAS President
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National criminal record office of the President's country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Business bank reference letter and proof of source of funds for initial capital

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-tier screening against French Trésor RG sanctions lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UN Security Council lists, and US OFAC SDN list; mandatory PEP classification per Code monétaire et financier L. 561-10 (two-tier domestic/foreign PEP regime) with enhanced due diligence on US$100k+ transactions; screening via independent AML database (e.g. World-Check/Dow Jones) with documented false-positive adjudication and 5-year record retention.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Data Portal (https://data.inpi.fr) — companies registration and name reservation via procedures.inpi.fr; historically managed by Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Dénomination sociale must be in Latin characters and may be in French or any EU language; non-Latin script names require a transliterated legal name; the name must be followed by legal form 'Société par Actions Simplifiée' or 'SAS' and share capital; must be distinctive against existing RCS entries and national trademarks (Code de la propriété intellectuelle L. 711-4).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of INPI refusal, the applicant files a recours gracieux addressed to the Director of INPI via registered mail (LRAR) with the original rejection notice and proposed amended name; if refused, the applicant may file a judicial appeal before the Cour d'appel de Paris (civil chamber) within one month of the notification; a second alternative name may be reserved concurrently at no additional administrative penalty.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office (domiciliation) is permissible solely for registered seat of the SAS administrative functions; commercial substance for medical device manufacturing (ISIC 3250) absolutely requires a physical production facility in France with quality system registration and ANSM authorization; the French tax administration may reclassify a purely virtual establishment as a non-resident under Article 209 B and apply substance-over-form doctrine.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk — 85% probability of unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months by ANSM (medical device market surveillance) and DGCCRF (consumer/product safety); subsequent annual inspection probability assessed at 70% given sterile glove classification under EU MDR 2017/745 Class Is/Ir boundary.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Buffer for document-specific volume variance and currency fluctuation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), principally Articles L.210-1 to L.210-9, L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1; corporate registration provisions in Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq.; beneficial-owner filing under Article L.561-46 of the Monetary and Financial Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI), with registration in the National Business Register (RNE) and, for commercial companies, the competent Commercial Court Registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Online declaration of incorporation and registration (formality unique), accompanied by the signed SAS articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and supporting evidence; the historical M0 form is incorporated into the electronic filing process.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital applies to an SAS; EUR 1 is legally sufficient, subject to adequate capitalization. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid upon incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Cash contributions are deposited into a bank or qualifying deposit account before registration and released after production of the Kbis extract. Contributions in kind generally require an independent contribution auditor unless a statutory exemption applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accept and approve the subscription of all issued shares in accordance with the articles of association and the subscription schedule, and that the subscribed cash capital be deposited with the designated depositary. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [full French address]. RESOLVED, that [name] be appointed President (Président) for an indefinite term, with authority to represent the Company within the limits of applicable law and the articles. RESOLVED, that [name] be appointed Director-General (Directeur Général), if applicable, and authorized to complete all incorporation, banking, tax, employment, regulatory, and licensing formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm corporate structure, objects, and regulated activity perimeter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Internal legal review; INPI Guichet unique requirements; competent Commercial Court Registry for local registration practice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Define the SAS shareholders, ownership percentages, President, optional Director-General, registered office, share capital, contribution terms, and precise corporate purpose. Separate medical-device manufacturing, PPE manufacturing, importation, distribution, and industrial processing activities. Confirm that the proposed registered office permits the intended use.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and registered office evidence
Power of attorney for filing representative, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Revise the corporate purpose or activity classification before filing. Obtain written landlord or domiciliation consent and replace any incomplete identity or address evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare, execute, and publish the articles package
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized journal for legal notices (journal d'annonces légales); notary only where a notarial act or real-estate contribution requires it
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare SAS articles covering governance, share transfers, decision rights, accounting year, capital, corporate purpose, and officer powers. Sign the articles electronically or in original form. Publish the statutory incorporation notice in an authorized legal-notice journal in the department of the registered office and retain the publication certificate.
required_dossiers: Contribution auditor report or exemption declaration, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the notice and republish if the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, or officer information is inaccurate. Preserve both the original and corrected certificates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit cash capital and obtain the deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations acting as authorized capital depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital-deposit account in the name of the company being formed. Submit the signed articles, shareholder identification, capital subscription evidence, draft legal notice, and source-of-funds information. Transfer the required paid-in cash amount and obtain the certificate of deposit.
required_dossiers: Draft legal notice or incorporation evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank AML queries with source-of-funds evidence, ownership charts, and certified identification. If the bank refuses onboarding, obtain a written refusal and approach another authorized depositary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the incorporation and beneficial-owner declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic filing, select SAS and the commercial manufacturing activities, upload the signed articles and all supporting documents, declare the beneficial owners, pay the electronic filing charges, and submit using the authorized representative's verified account. Ensure consistency across the articles, legal notice, capital certificate, address evidence, and officer data.
required_dossiers: President and officer declarations of non-conviction and parentage
Identity documents for officers and shareholders where requested
Industrial premises or lease evidence, where requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Monitor the INPI dashboard and answer the electronic deficiency notice within the stated deadline. Upload corrected documents in the requested format and preserve the submission receipt. A refusal may be challenged or resubmitted after curing the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration identifiers and activate the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI RNE and competent Commercial Court Registry; French tax administration and social-security portals
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the registration receipt and Kbis extract once issued. Confirm SIREN, SIRET, APE code, RCS registration, and beneficial-owner status. Request release of deposited capital, convert the temporary bank account into an operating account, register for applicable VAT and corporate tax obligations, and enroll as an employer before hiring personnel.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any identifier or activity-code error through the INPI modification process and notify the Commercial Court Registry and tax administration where the error affects legal or tax records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt post-incorporation governance and compliance controls
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company President, shareholders, accountant, and applicable French regulatory authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board or management resolution permitted by the articles, approve banking authorities, accounting policies, delegation limits, insurance, document retention, related-party controls, and regulatory responsibility assignments. Establish annual accounts, shareholder decision, beneficial-owner, workplace, product-quality, and environmental compliance calendars.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Document corrective resolutions, update delegations and registers, and file any required amendment through the INPI Guichet unique. Escalate statutory irregularities to French corporate counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain industrial, medical-device, environmental, and workplace clearances before production
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Departmental Prefecture and DREAL; ANSM; municipality; SDIS; labour inspectorate; notified body where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Classify the glove manufacturing installation under the ICPE nomenclature before construction or commissioning. Submit the applicable ICPE declaration, registration, or environmental authorization dossier. Establish MDR and PPE conformity routes, appoint an EU economic operator where relevant, implement quality and technical documentation, and obtain building, fire, occupational, waste, and discharge clearances before commercial production.
required_dossiers: Site plan, process flow, capacity, and equipment schedule
Environmental declaration, registration dossier, or authorization application
Medical-device technical documentation and quality-system evidence
Occupational risk assessment and prevention plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Do not commence regulated operations while a mandatory permit is pending. Cure dossier deficiencies, request a formal classification position from the Prefecture or DREAL, and appeal an adverse administrative decision under the applicable French administrative procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Departmental Prefecture, supported by the Regional Directorate for the Environment, Planning and Housing (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement, DREAL); ANSM and an EU notified body are additionally relevant for regulated medical devices.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Applicable Installation Classified for Environmental Protection (ICPE) authorization, registration, or declaration for polymer and glove-processing activities, determined by the ICPE nomenclature and production capacity. France has no single general factory licence for this activity, but sterile examination gloves require applicable medical-device conformity, CE marking, and market-registration obligations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: French Ministry for Ecological Transition, through the competent Regional Environmental Authority (Mission régionale d'autorité environnementale, MRAe) and the Departmental Prefecture/DREAL
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Site-specific screening under Articles L.122-1 and R.122-2 of the French Environmental Code. The project may require a full environmental-impact assessment, a case-by-case examination, or no EIA, depending on process, capacity, emissions, storage, land works, and applicable ICPE category.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No single national numeric limit applies to every nitrile-glove plant. Limits are set by the applicable ICPE order and, where relevant, the prefectural operating order. Compliance normally covers wastewater discharge authorization and pollutant limits, VOC and combustion-emission controls under applicable ICPE and EU Industrial Emissions requirements, hazardous-substance storage, waste segregation and traceability through Trackdéchets, and BAT-based controls where applicable. Unauthorized discharge, emission, or waste disposal is prohibited.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before commissioning, obtain municipal building and premises approvals where required, demonstrate fire-compartmentation, alarm, emergency access, extinguishing systems, chemical-storage controls, and evacuation arrangements to the Service départemental d'incendie et de secours (SDIS) and competent municipality. Complete structural load and machinery-installation assessments, electrical and pressure-equipment inspections, occupational-risk assessment, chemical-risk controls, machine guarding, worker training, and workplace documentation under the French Labour Code. Fire-safety clearance is especially required where the premises are an establishment open to the public or otherwise subject to a specific public-safety regime.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – taxation and VAT; Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) – customs and import controls. Official portals: https://www.impots.gouv.fr, https://www.formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, and https://www.douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must (1) determine whether its French activities constitute a fixed place of business or a permanent establishment (PE); (2) if a PE exists, file the French branch registration through the centralized company formalities service (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) providing certified copies of constitutional documents, director identification, power of attorney, and proof of a legal representative in France; DGFiP then assigns a SIREN/SIRET and a French VAT number; (3) if there is no French PE but taxable French supplies are made, the seller must apply for direct VAT registration with the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) using the form applicable to non-established taxable persons (No. 1515-SDK), providing the foreign VAT number, bank account details, and the effective date of first taxable supply; (4) customs operations require an EORI number issued by DGDDI for import and export declarations; (5) all statutory registrations must be completed before the first qualifying transaction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box regime exists in France. An SAS is automatically subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at entity level. Available statutory elections include: (a) tax consolidation ('intégration fiscale') under Article 223 A of the French General Tax Code (CGI) for at least 95%-owned French subsidiaries; (b) VAT grouping ('assujetti unique') under Article 256 C bis CGI; (c) tax-neutral rollover elections for certain corporate reorganisations under Articles 210 A and 210 B CGI; and (d) advance pricing arrangements for cross-border transfer pricing. Hybrid mismatch treatment is mandatory under Article 212 bis CGI and cannot be voluntarily opted out.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 0 for French-established taxable persons; registration is due from the first taxable transaction. For intra-EU distance sales of goods, the pan-EU threshold is EUR 10,000 annual turnover (unless the OSS scheme is selected). The domestic 'franchise en base de TVA' exemption provides a small-business VAT relief below EUR 85,000 (goods) and EUR 37,500 (services), but it is an exemption mechanism rather than a registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing becomes mandatory for domestic B2B transactions in France, phased from 1 September 2026 (large taxpayers) with full implementation for SMEs and ETIs by 1 September 2027. Invoices must be transmitted through certified private platforms (PDPs) or the public portal (Portail Public de Facturation – PPF) using structured commercial formats (UBL, CII, Factur-X). The regime integrates near real-time fiscal clearance of invoice and transaction data to DGFiP. No physical stamping is required, but electronic data must be complete, authentic, and interoperable with French public accounting systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies under Article 262 CGI where: (i) goods are physically exported outside the European Union by the supplier or on its behalf, and the export is supported by a customs export declaration accepted by DGDDI; (ii) goods are dispatched to another EU Member State and delivered to a customer holding a valid EU VAT number, with the corresponding recapitulative statement and transport evidence; (iii) services directly connected to exported goods, or international transport services, are supplied to a customer established outside French VAT territory. For sterile examination nitrile gloves, the manufacturer or exporter must hold a valid French or EU VAT number and must retain full commercial and customs evidence demonstrating the movement of goods out of France. For intra-EU supplies to a hospital, distributor or public body, the purchaser's valid EU VAT number and proof of transport are determinative.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAE) accepted by DGDDI
Bill of Lading (original or certified copy) or Airway Bill where applicable
Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and EUR.1 Movement Certificate or Exporter's Statement if preferential origin is claimed
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 wire evidence showing export proceeds credited to France
For intra-EU supplies: customer's valid EU VAT number, delivery note, CMR/CIM contract or equivalent transport proof, and the recapitulative statement (VI/SAF-T) filed with DGFiP
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French tax authorities may reopen VAT assessments within the statutory limitation period (3 years for timely filed VAT returns; up to 10 years where returns were omitted) and may retrospectively claw back zero-rating benefits where export documentation is absent, incomplete, fraudulent, or inconsistent with actual movement of goods. Reassessment includes unpaid VAT, monthly late interest (0.20%), a 40% error penalty, or a 80% penalty for bad faith and qualified tax fraud; criminal prosecution is possible in serious cases. Customs authorities may impose confiscation and fines under the French Customs Code. Company directors may also be held civilly and personally liable where the fraudulent export scheme is attributable to manifested inaction or deliberate misrepresentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible regime for both current and capital accounts under EU harmonization. Profit remittances to foreign shareholders are permitted following submission of corporate tax returns, beneficial ownership declarations, and any applicable withholding tax forms. No capital controls apply to legitimate business transactions; however, all FX transactions are subject to French AML/CFT monitoring and reporting thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds is required. Export receipts must be declared to customs authorities via the Douane system for statistical, VAT, and corporate tax purposes. Companies may retain foreign currency earnings in dedicated accounts or convert to euros at prevailing market rates without compelled surrender, subject only to standard transaction monitoring.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited viability for offshore EMIs due to strict French regulatory framework administered by the ACPR under PSD2 and the forthcoming MiCA regulation. Cross-border electronic money services targeting French residents require full licensing and may face operational restrictions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and account opening is permitted for French SAS entities using qualified electronic identification (FranceConnect or video verification). Physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard onboarding but may be required for enhanced due diligence or complex ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership not fully disclosed or opaque structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner register extracts, corporate structure charts, notarized declarations, and source of wealth evidence

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent transaction patterns or unexplained source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letters, audited financial statements, export contracts, board resolutions, and proof of legitimate PPE manufacturing activity

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from foreign parent entities are routed via SWIFT MT103 wires using purpose codes such as 'CAP' for capital contributions or 'EQTY' for equity. Verification requires matching against shareholder agreements, board minutes, tax residency certificates, and proof of funds origin. All inflows are subject to French exchange control monitoring and must be recorded in the company's accounting systems for tax compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for PPE exports utilize SWIFT MT103 for direct bank transfers or issuance of commercial letters of credit (LCs) confirmed by prime banks. Standard terms include 30-90 day LCs. All disbursements require prior export customs clearance, VAT registration compliance, and supporting documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards for specific exposure hedging
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for emerging market currencies
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for liquidity management
Option contracts for asymmetric risk protection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Financial Statements with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 6 months after fiscal year end (e.g., 30 June for FY ending 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines €1,500-€7,500, director sanctions, and risk of administrative dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Upon any change or annually to confirm status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to €7,500 for non-compliance with transparency obligations

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if turnover > €50 million, balance sheet total > €43 million, or average employees > 500
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (PCG) or IFRS for qualifying entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Maintain and update UBO information annually or upon changes; file updated declaration with RCS
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registre des Mandataires Sociaux)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 100-300 USD annually for registered office and agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0-4,000 USD depending on size and audit trigger

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard French impôt sur les sociétés rate for fiscal years closed on or after 1 January 2022; a reduced 15% rate applies to the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying small businesses with turnover below EUR 10 million
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% CIT rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit; 30% Crédit Impôt Recherche for eligible R&D expenditure up to EUR 100 million; 20% Crédit Impôt Innovation for SMEs; permanent payroll tax relief for production and automation investments; territorial tax aids and potentially reduced capital gains treatment on industrial assets. All incentives require robust technical files and French corporate substance.
